recalled_knowledge.item: Anapole reduction after photon EOM: c8^N = 2 e A Q_N, c9^N = e A g_N for L = A chibar g^mu g5 chi d^nu F_{mu nu}
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Fitzpatrick et al. 2012 (A-V -> 2O8+2O9), Gresham & Zurek 2014, Del Nobile 2021 review; confirmed numerically by directdm output in work/P031

recalled_knowledge.item: EDM reduction: c11^N = 2 e d_E Q_N m_N / q^2 for L = (d_E/2) chibar sigma^{mu nu} i g5 chi F_{mu nu}
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Fitzpatrick et al. 2012; Banks-Fox-Weiner 2010; confirmed numerically by directdm C52 output in work/P031

recalled_knowledge.item: Axial-vector(DM) x vector(N) -> 2 O8 + 2 O9; tensor F2 piece adds 2 F2 O9
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Fitzpatrick et al. 2012 Table 1 / Anand et al. 2014
